label: Log–log map of %n literature operating conditions of welding and metal additive manufacturing in dimensionless velocity and power. Selected: %m by %p, aspect ratio %a.
caption: Each point is a published operating condition of welding or metal additive manufacturing, made dimensionless with the Rosenthal moving-point-source solution: processes, alloys and machines collapse onto one plane. Lines of constant aspect ratio A_r run diagonally; below the white curve the melt pool is narrower than the required half-width R̄. Select a point for its melt-pool shape.
provenance: From the literature reviews behind Moda, Chiocca et al., Materials & Design 223 (2022) 110991 (updated datasets): %n operating conditions of arc and beam welding, LMD and SLM with the thermophysical properties used. Ũ and P̃ follow Eqs. (20–21), with nominal power; the outline is the exact isotherm of Eq. (2); A_r isolines use Eq. (12) and the boundary Eq. (22). EBM and friction stir welding, a solid-state process, are left out.
